_comment: Per-(city,FY) GAAP/Cash basis for MN cities, derived from the Governmental Funds GAAPInd column (MNCITY-02, CONTEXT D-02). No DB schema change — this committed file is the per-entity basis record. GAAPInd encodings vary by year: text GAAP/Cash (FY2018-2019,2023), numeric -1=GAAP/0=Cash (FY2016,2020-2022), and ABSENT (FY2012-2015,2017 -> basis unavailable). Generated 2026-06-27 by loadMNOSA entityBasis across the cired_<YY> workbooks.
source: Minnesota Office of the State Auditor City/County Finances Report
